I guess we'll know after this next harvest.|Lieutenant Krole to Bix Caleen|}} '''Council Six Hundred''' was a [[farm]]ing [[city|settlement]] on the agricultural world [[Mina-Rau]]. By [[4 BBY]],{{AndorDate|202}} [[Bix Caleen]] visited the settlement after it built new [[mega silo]]s. In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] started a small conversation Caleen by mentioning the new silos at the Six Hundred block. ==Behind the scenes== Council Six Hundred was mentioned during the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=საბჭო ექვსასი }} [[Category:Mina-Rau locations]] [[Category:Settlements]]
